title: Consecutive Alternation Detection
scenario: Find IDs where the number alternates (1, 2, 1) at least 3 times in a row. Return 'id'.
hint: Compare IDs and numbers with LAG/LEAD offsets.
correctQuery: SELECT l2.id FROM logs l1 JOIN logs l2 ON l1.id = l2.id - 1 JOIN logs l3 ON l2.id = l3.id - 1 WHERE l1.num = l3.num AND l1.num != l2.num;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '2'), (3, '1');
